readers.heading: No feed reader yet?
readers.intro: All of these are free to start, and all but Inoreader are open source. Pick the one that suits you, then paste the address above into it:
readers.netnewswire: if you only use Apple devices and don't want an account. For Mac, iPhone and iPad, kept in sync through iCloud.
readers.newsblur: if you want one account on all your devices. Apps for Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android, plus the web, kept in sync. Free for up to 64 sites, and around since 2010.
readers.folo: if you want apps on everything, including Windows and Linux. Kept in sync, free for up to 150 feeds, with AI summaries if you want them.
readers.fluentreader: if you read on a Windows, Mac or Linux computer and don't want an account. A clean desktop app; your feeds stay on that computer.
readers.feeder: if you read on an Android phone and don't want an account. A simple app; your feeds stay on that phone.
readers.inoreader: if you want the most features: rules, filters, search and more. On the web, iPhone and Android, kept in sync, free for up to 150 feeds (the free plan shows ads).
